page_title: NME Drug and New Biologic Approvals in 2002

rows.indication: Orfadin provides for the use for adjunctive therapy to dietary restriction of tyrosine and phenylalanine in the treatment of hereditary tyrosinemia type 1.
Benicar is indicated for the treatment of hypertension.
Faslodex is indicated for the treatment of hormone receptor positive metastatic breast cancer in postmenopausal women with disease progression following antiestrogen therapy.
Remodulin is indicated for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH).

Vfend is indicated for the treatment of invasive aspergillosis and serious fungal infections caused by Scedosporium apiospermum and Fusarium spp., including Fusarium solani, in patients intolerant of, or refractory to, other therapy.
Imagent is indicated for the use in patients with suboptimal echocardiograms to opacify the left ventricular chamber and to improve the delineation of the left ventricular endocardial border.
Xyrem is indicated for the treatment of cataplexy associated with narcolepsy.
Zelnorm is indicated for the short-term treatment of women with irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) whose primary bowel symptom is constipation.

Eloxatin is indicated in combination with infusional 5-FU/LV for the treatment of patients with metastatic carcinoma of the colon or rectum whose disease has recurred or progressed during or within 6 months of completion of first line therapy with the combination of bolus 5-FU/LV and irinotecan.

Hepsera is indicated for the treatment of chronic hepatitis B in adults with evidence of active viral replication and either evidence of persistent elevations in serum alanine aminotransferase (ALT)/aspartate aminotransferase (AST) or histologically active disease.
Inspra is indicated for the treatment of hypertension, alone or in combination with other agents.

Zetia is indicated for (1) Primary hypercholesterolemia - as adjunctive therapy to diet for reduction of elevated total-C, LDL-C and Apo B in patients with primary (heterozygous familial and non-familial) hypercholestrolemia either alone or with an HMG-Co A reductase inhibitor. (2) Homozygous familial hypercholesterolemai - in combination with either atorvastatin or simvastatin, as an adjunct to other lipid-lowering treatments (e.g., LDL apheresis) or, if such treatments are unavailable, in combination with either atorvastatin or simvastatin alone. (3) Homozygous familial sitosterolemia - as adjunctive therapy to diet for the reduction of elevated sitosterol and campesterol levels. [FDA table prints 'hypercholestrolemia' and 'hypercholesterolemai' as shown; verbatim.]
Abilify is indicated for the treatment of schizophrenia.
Alinia is indicated for the treatment of diarrhea caused by Cryptosporidium parvum and Giardia lamblia.
Strattera is indicated for the treatment of Attention-Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) for children and adolescents ages 6-18 and adults.

Extraneal is indicated for a single daily exchange for the long (8-16-hour) dwell during continuous ambulatory peritoneal dialysis (CAPD) or automated peritoneal dialysis (APD) for the management of chronic renal failure.
Replax is indicated for the acute treatment of migrane. [FDA table prints 'Replax' in indication text though brand column reads 'Relpax', and 'migrane'; verbatim.]
